env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This eval builds, deploys, and validates an RT-CV detection/tracking delta. The build label is `in-2`, never a Compose profile. Detection events must reach Kafka topic `mdx-raw` and Elasticsearch; streamed and uploaded media must remain retrievable through VIOS. Prefer person-containing warehouse samples such as `warehouse_sample.mp4` or `sample-warehouse-ladder.mp4` when runtime validation needs a local MP4. Evaluator context: the expected smallest delta is from the current `search` developer profile, retaining VIOS, RT-CV, Kafka, Logstash, Elasticsearch, and Kibana/dashboard services while excluding embeddings, Search analytics/API, Agent/UI/ingress, tracing, RT-VLM critique, and LLM inference; retaining Kibana/dashboard services includes both `kibana` and `kibana-init-container-search`; `ENABLE_CRITIC=false` is expected when critique is excluded.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build this deployment under `_builds/in-2/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand object detection and multi-object tracking for class `person` using RT-DETR on RT-CV. Keep streamed and uploaded video retrievable through VIOS. Publish bounding boxes, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs to Kafka and store them in Elasticsearch." Target `{{platform}}`, validate the resolved Compose configuration including RT-CV Kafka output wiring to `mdx-raw`, do not deploy, and do not create, modify, or delete anything under `deploy/docker/`.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-2/override.env` exists and declares `FOUNDATION=search` and the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`.

The exact set therefore excludes `rtvi-embed`, `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`, `vss-video-analytics-api-fusion`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-haproxy-ingress`, `phoenix`, and LLM NIM keys.
`perception-2d-fusion` is used as the RT-CV key; `perception-2d` and `perception-alerts` are not substituted.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no `in-2`, aggregate, `bp_developer_*`, or other invented profile key.

The delta contains required build-local path/host values and only customized environment values that differ from the Search Foundation, such as `HARDWARE_PROFILE=RTXPRO6000BW`, `ENABLE_CRITIC=false`, RT-CV model/device settings, source count, paths, and reachable host values; unchanged Search defaults are not copied, and no copied Search `.env` or `overrides.env` file is used as the delta artifact.
`_builds/in-2/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, and `_builds/in-2/patches/` is absent because all selected services exist and no service definition changes are requested.

The build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) and no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.

Resolution uses `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and `_builds/in-2/override.env`, in that order, with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, required peers resolve, excluded services do not resolve, no selected profile token is unknown, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real unescaped `${...}` Compose interpolation remains unresolved, escaped `$${...}` container-shell variables are not counted as unresolved interpolation, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains, and `validate_resolved_yml.py` accepts all checked-in bind sources without requiring generated runtime placeholders to be pre-created.

The effective RT-CV output path remains Kafka-backed: `STREAM_TYPE=kafka` is inherited or set, `DS_MESSAGE_RATE` is absent or nonzero, `perception-2d-fusion` resolves with the Search DeepStream Kafka config whose `msg-broker-conn-str` and `topic` target `mdx-raw`, and `logstash` remains selected to index `mdx-raw` into Elasticsearch.
No file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted.

expects.query: Deploy the validated `_builds/in-2/resolved.yml` directly as the only Compose file, wait for selected services to become ready, and leave the deployment running for runtime validation. Do not create or use helper Compose overrides such as `no-cpu-limit.yml`; if `resolved.yml` itself cannot deploy, report that blocker. Treat the generated deployment as immutable during and after deployment: do not edit files under `deploy/docker/`, do not regenerate the build, and do not patch service configs while diagnosing readiness.
checks: Deployment uses the validated `_builds/in-2/resolved.yml` as the only Compose file and starts it with `docker compose ... up -d`; harmless deployment options such as `-p <project>` or `--build` are allowed, but it must not re-read Foundation env files, supply `--profile`, use an invented Compose profile, or deploy a copied Compose project.

All selected long-running containers are present and not exited, restarting, or dead; all selected one-shot containers exit 0; and excluded services are not running. A Docker `unhealthy` label alone is not a failure when the explicit service readiness probes in this step pass.
`curl -sf http://localhost:${RTVI_CV_HOST_PORT:-9000}/ready` returns HTTP 200, and RT-CV reports the requested RT-DETR/person configuration.

Elasticsearch cluster health, Kafka broker/topic readiness, VIOS APIs, and the NvStreamer API become reachable; `curl -sf http://localhost:${NVSTREAMER_HTTP_HOST_PORT:-31000}/api/v1/sensor/version` returns JSON whose `type` is `streamer`.

expects.query: Validate IN-2 end to end without changing the deployment or any file under `deploy/docker/`. First record Kafka `mdx-raw` end offsets as the baseline. Use a person-containing warehouse sample video for both paths, preferring `warehouse_sample.mp4` or `sample-warehouse-ladder.mp4` from repository or host sample-data directories: upload it to VIOS for stored playback, and serve it as a live RTSP source through NvStreamer. For the live path, verify NvStreamer reports `type=streamer`, read the RTSP URL from NvStreamer APIs, register that RTSP URL with VIOS, and drive RT-CV from the VIOS live-proxy RTSP URL discovered at runtime. Do not use `file://`, local filesystem paths, or direct NvStreamer RTSP URLs as substitutes for the VIOS live-proxy source. Confirm RT-CV metrics or logs show active processing for the VIOS sensor before recording the final offsets. After RT-CV processes the live source, record Kafka `mdx-raw` end offsets again, confirm they increased, and confirm Elasticsearch indexes detection/tracking documents. If NvStreamer cannot start or bind its port, report that blocker instead of substituting another source type. In the final response, use these concise evidence sections: Foundation, Effective delta, Changed knobs, Readiness, Playback, Kafka, Elasticsearch. Leave services running unless cleanup is explicitly requested.
checks: An uploaded warehouse video is retrievable through VIOS playback or clip APIs.
A live NvStreamer source is registered with VIOS and RT-CV is driven from the actual VIOS live-proxy RTSP URL discovered at runtime.
Kafka `mdx-raw` end offsets are recorded before and after live processing and increase.
Elasticsearch contains RT-CV metadata attributable to the processed sensor, including bounding boxes, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs.

No file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted, and the final response reports the Foundation, effective delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka, and Elasticsearch evidence.
